 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER

$function$

lock_notification_auth_activity().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_notification_auth_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

  return null;
end $function$

lock_notification_auth_revocation().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_notification_auth_revocation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- A multi-statement Auth transaction may already hold a shared activity
  -- gate. Never wait while upgrading that lock: another shared reader could
  -- be waiting for this transaction's Auth row. Abort atomically for a whole
  -- transaction retry instead of forming an upgrade deadlock.
  if exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_locks where locktype='advisory'
      and pid=pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid() and classid=193517 and objid=141
      and objsubid=2 and mode='ShareLock' and granted)
    and not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_locks where locktype='advisory'
      and pid=pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid() and classid=193517 and objid=141
      and objsubid=2 and mode='ExclusiveLock' and granted) then
    if not pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(193517,141) then
      raise exception 'notification_auth_revocation_retry' using errcode='40001';
    end if;
  else
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(193517,141);
  end if;
  return null;
end $function$

_notification_session_is_live(uuid,uuid).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notification_session_is_live(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s join auth.users u on u.id=s.user_id
    where s.id=p_session and s.user_id=p_user and s.created_at is not null and isfinite(s.created_at)
      and s.aal::text in ('aal1','aal2')
      and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp())
      and u.deleted_at is null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
      and (u.phone_confirmed_at is not null or u.email_confirmed_at is not null)
      and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp()));
$function$

collect_admin_access.platform_admin(uuid.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_admin_access.platform_admin(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (auth.jwt()->>'role'='service_role' or p_user=auth.uid())
    and collect_admin_access.caller_eligible(p_user)
    and exists(select 1 from public.admin_user_roles ur join public.admin_roles r on r.id=ur.role_id
      where ur.user_id=p_user and ur.revoked_at is null and r.name='platform_owner');
$function$

collect_admin_access.caller_eligible(uui.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_admin_access.caller_eligible(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare session_key text := auth.jwt()->>'session_id';
begin
  if not collect_admin_access.approved_identity(p_user) then return false; end if;
  if auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'service_role' then return true; end if;
  if auth.role() is distinct from 'authenticated' then return false; end if;
  if p_user is distinct from auth.uid() or session_key is null
    or session_key !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' then
    return false;
  end if;
  if current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' then
    raise exception 'admin_snapshot_retry' using errcode='40001';
  end if;
  return exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s join auth.users u on u.id=s.user_id
    join public.admin_user_roles ur on ur.user_id=u.id and ur.revoked_at is null
    join public.admin_roles r on r.id=ur.role_id and r.name='platform_owner'
    where s.id=session_key::uuid and s.user_id=p_user
      and public._notification_session_is_live(s.id,p_user) and s.created_at<=statement_timestamp()
      and s.created_at>=ur.created_at
      and (exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.email_approvals a
        where a.user_id=p_user and collect_admin_access.email_identity(p_user) and s.created_at>=a.approved_at)
       or (exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.operator_auth_policy where id and mode='transition')
        and exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.whatsapp_approvals a where a.user_id=p_user
         and a.revoked_at is null and (a.expires_at is null or a.expires_at>statement_timestamp())
         and a.phone_e164=collect_admin_access.verified_phone(p_user) and s.created_at>=a.approved_at))));
end$function$

collect_admin_access.approved_identity(u.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_admin_access.approved_identity(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select collect_admin_access.email_identity(p_user) or
  (not exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.email_approvals where user_id=p_user)
   and exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.operator_auth_policy where id and mode='transition')
   and exists(select 1 from collect_admin_access.whatsapp_approvals a
    where a.user_id=p_user and a.revoked_at is null
     and (a.expires_at is null or a.expires_at>statement_timestamp())
     and a.phone_e164=collect_admin_access.verified_phone(p_user)))
$function$
